title: GNOME withdraws a proposed AI policy
summary: A project-wide policy on generative AI was proposed on November 19 and withdrawn by its author on November 23.

topics.angle: Who sets the rules when volunteers, donors and corporate partners disagree.
The partner money behind a rules decision.

claims.text: The proposal allowed private AI use, barred AI-made code, documentation, issues and reviews, and let projects opt out.
The author formally withdrew it at 14:36 UTC on November 23 and gave no reason in that post.
At 12:23 UTC the same day Allan Day raised concerns, including corporate partnerships worth $736,000 in the last financial year; later that day Day put donations at about $230,000.
None of the 184 posts read names Omarchy or DHH.
